Class Measurement3d

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.spatial.Measurement3d
public class Measurement3d extends Object
Measurements of the iso surface and the volume in the 3D view. The results are displayed in new sheets of the Bio7 table:
  • The objects of the iso surface (connected parts of the mesh): volume, surface area, sphericity, centroid, ellipsoid axes, Feret diameter, holes, bounding box.
  • The statistics of the voxels in the region of the clipping (box, plane and mask) and the volume above a threshold.
  • Points picked with the mouse on the displayed data (the position, the value and the distances like a ruler, see Clipping.TOOL_PICK).
The values are calibrated (the unit of the image).

    • measureIsoSurface

      public double[][] measureIsoSurface(boolean showTable)
      Measures the objects (connected parts) of the iso surface mesh, sorted by the volume. The axes are the lengths of the axes of the ellipsoid with the same moments of inertia. Holes is the number of tunnels (genus). Mean Inside Value is the mean of the data one voxel inside of the surface.
      Parameters:
      showTable - true displays the results in a new sheet of the Bio7 table
      Returns:
      a row for each object with the values of ISO_COLUMNS or null if no surface is available

    • measureDistances

      public double[][][] measureDistances(boolean showTable)
      Measures the distances between the objects of the iso surface (the objects are measured again, see measureIsoSurface): for every object the nearest neighbor of the centroids and of the surfaces (edge to edge: the shortest distance between the triangles), the matrices of all centroid and surface distances and the Clark-Evans index R of the centroids (3D, R invalid input: '<' 1 clustered, R = 1 random, R > 1 regular, without an edge correction). The nearest surface points are connected with lines in the 3D view.
      Parameters:
      showTable - true displays the results in new sheets of the Bio7 table
      Returns:
      {nearest[n][DISTANCE_COLUMNS], centroid matrix[n][n] (null for more than 500 objects), surface matrix[n][n] (null for more than 150 objects)} or null if no surface is available

    • measureRegion

      public double[] measureRegion(boolean showTable)
      Measures the voxels of the displayed stack (the full resolution of the ImageJ image or the data of a model) in the region of the clipping (the box, the cutting plane and the mask, the whole stack without a clipping). The threshold is the iso value (if an iso surface of the data is available) or the threshold of the image (else NaN). The values of an RGB stack are the luminance 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B (like the iso surface), the values of a 64-bit stack are read in double.
      Parameters:
      showTable - true displays the results in a new sheet of the Bio7 table
      Returns:
      the values of REGION_COLUMNS or null if no data is available

    • deleteSelected

      public void deleteSelected(boolean whole)
      Deletes the active point of the selected measurement (the last pressed or added point) or, if whole is true, the selected measurement. A line, a polygon or a freehand area with too few points (a straight line, an angle) is deleted. The measurement is measured again and the tables are updated.
      Parameters:
      whole - true deletes the selected measurement

    • removeAreaSurface

      public boolean removeAreaSurface()
      Removes the surface of the selected area (else of the last measured area with a surface: a polygon, a freehand area, an object or a cavity) from the displayed iso surface: the surface is cut open (e.g., to measure inside of an object). The removed parts are kept when the surface is computed again; see IsoSurface.undoRemoval, redoRemoval and restoreSurface. The measurement of the objects uses the complete surface.
      Returns:
      true if a part of the surface has been removed

      public void setCavityFreeSpace(boolean freeSpace)
      The volume of a clicked cavity (its wall): true without the objects which float in it (the free space), false the whole space inside of the wall.

    • isCavityFreeSpace

      public boolean isCavityFreeSpace()
      Returns true if the volume of a clicked cavity is its free space (see setCavityFreeSpace).

    • setObjectFilled

      public void setObjectFilled(boolean filled)
      The volume of a clicked object: true the filled volume (inside of its outer surface, with its cavities), false the volume of its material (the outer surface without the cavities).

    • isObjectFilled

      public boolean isObjectFilled()
      Returns true if the volume of a clicked object is its filled volume (see setObjectFilled).

    • setShowVolumesThrough

      public void setShowVolumesThrough(boolean show)
      Shows the measured volumes (objects, cavities, outlines) as transparent bodies through the surface, e.g., a cavity inside of the object.

      Returns true if the measured volumes are shown through the surface.

    • setShowOnlyVolumes

    • isShowNumbers

      public boolean isShowNumbers()

    • setDecimals

      public void setDecimals(int digits)
      Sets the number of decimals of the values in the tables and in the CSV files of the matrices (default 4). -1 shows the full precision: the shortest decimal number which gives the same double value when it is read (no rounding).
      Parameters:
      digits - the decimals (0 - 15) or -1 for the full precision

    • getDecimals

      public int getDecimals()
      Returns the decimals of the tables (see setDecimals, -1 = full precision).
